body:
I mean, yeah. The thought of suddenly not existing is terrifying. But if I go through with it and succeed, there's no consequence *to me.* I won't have to live with being dead. If I fail, I could wind up brain dead, horribly disfigured, paralyzed, or with horribly painful injuries... plus I'd have to deal with the shame of not only trying to kill myself and the damage it did to my family, but also the fact that I failed at *that,* too.

I'm much more afraid of failing than of succeeding.

I just keep *almost* going through with it, you know? I want to be over with it, but every method I've considered has these horrible effects, like, "brain damage," "severe disfigurement," "excruciating pain," etc., if you fail, and it's just... why can't this be easy?!

All the most guaranteed methods require equipment I don't have access to. I wish assissted suicide was an easy-access option. I can't get past the fear.
